intro: One way to know a place is to run in it. Twenty-plus halves, about fifteen fulls, a fair number of them in Karnataka. This is not a calendar of every bib in the state. It is races I have already run and races I still want: 10K, half, full, and ultra. The 10Ks here are the ones worth racing, not the ones with the biggest banner. Dates move. Check the organiser before you book a train.

races.name: Wipro Bengaluru Marathon
races.blurb: The city's AIMS-certified full. Not the TCS World 10K, which is a different race and a 10K. Flag-off from Kanteerava. If you want a Bengaluru marathon, this is the one with a 42.2.

races.name: TCS World 10K Bengaluru
races.blurb: AIMS-certified and genuinely fast: the elite World 10K has been won in under 28 minutes. Kanteerava to Kanteerava on closed roads. The timing certificate is accepted as a qualifier by races elsewhere, which is the real test of a 10K.

races.name: Bengaluru 10K Challenge
races.blurb: Billed as the tougher 10K, and it is: concrete NICE Road, rolling climbs, no shade. Chip-timed with a 90-minute cut-off. Run it when you want an honest 10K, not a flat one.

races.name: Bengaluru Midnight Marathon
races.blurb: Run by Rotary Bangalore IT Corridor, flagged off at night. Loops of about 5.3 km, so the distance is honest and the company is constant. The city after the traffic dies is a different map of the same roads.

races.name: Bangalore Ultra
races.blurb: Called India's oldest ultramarathon. Campus loops at GKVK: you pass the finish more than once before you are allowed to stop. Monsoon edition is wet underfoot.

races.name: Kaveri Trail Marathon
races.blurb: First run in 2007, India's oldest trail marathon, along the canal by Ranganathittu. Birds, fields, heat once the sun is up. A Bengaluru runner's standard pilgrimage, an hour from the city.

races.name: Mysuru Marathon
races.blurb: Heritage streets, then the hill. The full has a real climb. Cut-offs are strict. Go for Chamundi, not a flat personal best.

races.name: Malnad Ultra
races.blurb: Coffee-estate trails in the Malnad. Volunteer-run since 2016. Climbs, slush, and a night 50 if you want the dark. This is the Western Ghats, not a city loop.

races.name: Hampi Ultra
races.blurb: Boulders, river, and the old city as the course. Heat arrives early. Run it if you already come to Hampi for the ruins; the miles make the stones slower to leave.

races.name: The Coffee Trails
races.blurb: Estate trails in Kodagu. Shorter than Malnad's 100, still a day in the Ghats. Coorg also throws a half on the calendar most years; this is the longer trail bib.

races.name: Manipal Marathon
races.blurb: Student-organised out of MAHE and better run than that sounds. Campus and town roads on the coast, humidity you do not get on the plateau. Eighth edition in 2026.

races.name: Udupi Marathon
races.blurb: Temple town, coastal air, flatter than Manipal up the road. Timed at every distance. Finish and go find a Udupi breakfast where the Udupi breakfast comes from.

races.name: Mangalore Marathon
races.blurb: Coast road, port air. Pair it with a bun and goli bajje after, not a protein bar.

races.name: Nandi Hills Run
races.blurb: The hill you already drive for sunrise, on foot. Gradient is the point. Fog on the hairpins if the clouds sit.

races.name: Vrukshathon Heritage Run
races.blurb: Vijayapura's own, run since 2016 for tree cover and the monuments. The route goes past Gol Gumbaz and Gagan Mahal, which is the reason to travel for it. Twenty thousand-plus entries now, so register early.

races.name: Rotary Belagavi Half Marathon
races.when: November, and it has moved around the calendar
races.blurb: Rotary Club of Venugram has run this since 2008, which makes it the oldest bib in North Karnataka. Cantonment roads, cool morning, timed. The 2025 February edition added a full, the first in the region. The club's own site keeps going down, so look for the current year's registration link.

races.name: Hubballi Half Marathon
races.blurb: North Karnataka road half. Cooler winter morning than Bengaluru's April. Kasuti country, not Cubbon.

races.name: Tata Mumbai Marathon
races.blurb: The big-city full most Indian marathoners put on the list. Sea, flyovers, crowd. Not Karnataka. Still a race I keep on the board.

races.name: Auroville Marathon
races.blurb: Red earth, casuarina, and a start that is not a stadium. Pondicherry is where I was born. This one is personal geography as much as a bib.

races.name: Hyderabad Marathon
races.blurb: Deccan plateau, tank bund air. I have lived in Telangana for work. The course is a way back into that city that is not an office.

races.name: Chennai Marathon
races.blurb: Marina humidity even in January. Tamil Nadu is on the school-and-company map. Run it for the coast, not for a cool morning.
